cue.heading: The two saving clauses

compare.title: Clean Water Act
compare.text: … nothing in this chapter shall (1) preclude or deny the right of any State … to adopt or enforce (A) any standard or limitation respecting <mark>discharges of pollutants</mark>, or (B) any requirement respecting control or abatement of pollution …

compare.title: Clean Air Act
compare.text: … nothing in this chapter shall preclude or deny the right of any State … to adopt or enforce (1) any standard or limitation respecting <mark>emissions of air pollutants</mark> or (2) any requirement respecting control or abatement of air pollution …

highlight: savings clause for the Clean Water Act and the Clean Air Act
